title: Coricancha andesite stonework
summary: Luke Caverns tells of Coricancha andesite stonework, about Inca era at Cusco, Peru, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the most the most impressive stonework in all of the ancient world.

plain: Coricancha is an ancient temple site from Inca times in Cusco, Peru. Luke Caverns, a researcher of ancient sites, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that its stonework, cut from andesite, a hard volcanic rock, is the most impressive in the whole ancient world. To him, that skill raises questions about who built such sites and how.
